name: Vealth Work Control Plane
purpose: A machine-readable entry point for agents and institutions to discover bounded work and understand the authority, proof, receipt, and delegation rules before any action is proposed.

discovery_endpoints.returns: Live open work-packet summaries with method, proof rule, location, skill level, and payment or credit condition.
One machine-readable work packet; the human presentation is /work/{workId}, not this endpoint.
The MCP connection description; call tools/list on the same endpoint for the live tool registry.

authority_model.meaning: Authority to define the desired outcome or delegate a narrower work envelope.
Authority to read or mutate Vealth protocol state; API reachability is not write authority.
Authority to commit or release money; x402 payment buys access, not economic authority.
Authority to observe or modify a named real resource, site, system, person, or property.
Authority to submit evidence or independently verify proof and close a work packet.

risk_tiers.description: Read-only or observation work that does not modify the named resource.
risk_tiers.minimum_gate: Named resource scope, access permission, method, proof fields, and a human gate where the domain requires it.

risk_tiers.description: Defensive repository or system maintenance bounded to an explicitly authorized asset.
risk_tiers.minimum_gate: Repository owner authority, environment scope, change boundary, rollback or review path, and separate proof review.

risk_tiers.description: Physical construction, retrofit, cleaning, food, water, tree, or ecosystem work.
risk_tiers.minimum_gate: Owner or operator access, competent or licensed roles where required, safety stop rules, field proof, and human verification.

risk_tiers.description: Work involving regulated, safety-critical, clinical, financial, legal, or irreversible effects.
risk_tiers.minimum_gate: Explicit institutional authority and operator-approved domain-specific review; discovery never substitutes for that authority.

adapters.authority_rule: MCP exposes tools; a tool name or reachability never enlarges the caller's WorkGrant authority.
An agent-to-agent message may propose work but cannot issue a Vealth grant or bypass the canonical validator.
x402 payment authenticates a paid API call; it does not grant protocol write, economic, world, truth, or publication authority.

delegation.rule: A child grant may only narrow a validated parent; it may never add action, scope, time, budget, velocity, authority, publication, or payment power.

mandate.rule: A StewardshipMandate records why a principal may provision a class of work. It is a record, not authority: it issues no grant, dispatches nobody, releases no payment, and never widens a grant it names.

lookup.for_grant: Read the mandate whose grants[] names the grant id; when it does not appear, follow the grant's delegation_parent chain and read the mandate that names an ancestor.
lookup.for_work_packet: Read the grants bound to the packet's work id, then resolve each of those grant ids the same way; the packet sits under the first mandate that resolves.

not_claimed: This manifest does not issue a WorkGrant or authorize a caller to act.
This manifest does not issue a StewardshipMandate, and a recorded mandate is never itself authority to act.
This manifest does not enable live subgrant creation or swarm delegation.
This manifest does not dispatch workers or select contractors.
This manifest does not move money, settle wages, or mint any asset.
This manifest does not verify physical proof or declare an ecological outcome.
This manifest does not replace permits, licenses, competent persons, or institutional authority.
This manifest does not make a payment, identity, endpoint, or model confidence into authority.
